description: Known transcription mishearings for Anthropic / Claude content. Each entry is an EXPLICIT wrong form, matched case-insensitively on word boundaries. Never add a bare common word (e.g. 'cloud') -- 'cloud provider', 'cloud computing', 'cloud API' are legitimate phrases and must not be flagged. Correct spellings in any casing (e.g. 'claude code') are not mishearings.
